about_us_desc: MWN Software is a leading provider of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, delivering innovative digital solutions across multiple industries.
about_company_desc: MWN Software specializes in developing advanced ERP systems tailored for various industries including transportation, logistics, manufacturing, and healthcare. We deliver innovative, reliable, and secure digital solutions that empower businesses to optimize their operations and achieve sustainable growth through our proprietary i-app framework.
about_product_desc: Tazkarh is one of our comprehensive ERP solutions designed specifically for transportation and shipping companies. It integrates all essential modules including fleet management, operations, ticketing, maintenance, and analytics to streamline daily operations and enhance decision-making.
about_technology_desc: Built on our proprietary i-app framework, Tazkarh provides unparalleled efficiency, speed, accuracy, and security. This custom-developed framework ensures optimal performance and scalability for all our digital products.
about_deployment_desc: Our systems are available on a SaaS basis with annual subscriptions and dedicated cloud services for each company. Alternatively, they can be installed on client servers with comprehensive management and maintenance services provided by our expert team.
about_standards_desc: MWN Software adheres to the highest international standards in design, management, and security. Our systems comply with ISO 9001 standards and other specialized certifications, ensuring quality, reliability, and data protection.
about_mission_text: To empower transportation companies with cutting-edge technology that drives operational excellence, enhances customer satisfaction, and supports sustainable business growth.
value_integrity_desc: We maintain transparency, ethical practices, and unwavering commitment to our partners and customers.
value_innovation_desc: We continuously innovate to solve complex operational challenges and deliver state-of-the-art solutions.
value_support_desc: We provide exceptional, responsive support and comprehensive documentation to ensure our clients' success.
about_strength_1: Proprietary i-app framework ensuring optimal performance and security
about_strength_2: Dedicated support team with industry expertise
about_strength_3: Compliance with international standards and certifications
about_strength_4: Cloud-native architecture ensuring reliability and scalability
solutions_desc: Integrated modules for fleet, operations, ticketing and maintenance — built for bus operators of all sizes.
solutions_problem_1: Manual and inefficient fleet management leading to downtime and increased costs
solutions_problem_2: Complex scheduling and route planning causing operational delays
solutions_problem_3: Outdated ticketing systems resulting in lost revenue and customer dissatisfaction
solutions_problem_4: Reactive maintenance practices leading to unexpected breakdowns
solutions_saas_desc: Access Tazkarh through our secure cloud platform with annual subscriptions. Enjoy automatic updates, scalable infrastructure, and 24/7 support.
solutions_onpremise_desc: Deploy Tazkarh on your own servers with a certificate of use. Full control over your data and infrastructure, with comprehensive maintenance services.
solutions_wordpress_desc: Embed our booking system directly into your WordPress website with our custom plugin. Provide seamless booking experiences to your customers.
solutions_iframe_desc: Integrate the booking interface into any HTML page using iframe technology. Easy implementation with full customization options.
solutions_benefit_1: Reduce operational costs by up to 30%
solutions_benefit_2: Increase revenue through optimized pricing and capacity management
solutions_benefit_3: Improve customer satisfaction with modern, user-friendly interfaces
solutions_benefit_4: Minimize downtime with predictive maintenance and real-time monitoring
sol_fleet_desc: Manage buses, layouts, registrations and availability from a single dashboard.
sol_ops_desc: Create trip templates, schedules and assign buses and crews efficiently.
sol_ticket_desc: Search, book, issue and manage tickets with PNR tracking and payments.
sol_maint_desc: Plan maintenance, track work orders and inventory to reduce downtime.
features_intro: Discover the full suite of powerful modules and capabilities in the Tazkarh platform, designed to transform bus operations with advanced fleet management, seamless ticketing, and intelligent analytics.
feat_fleet_desc: Comprehensive tools for defining, tracking, and optimizing your bus fleet with detailed vehicle profiles, maintenance schedules, and real-time availability monitoring.
feat_fleet_point_1: Complete bus registry with plate numbers, legal compliance dates, and registration tracking
feat_fleet_point_2: Interactive seat layout designer with import/export capabilities and visual editor
feat_fleet_point_3: Intelligent bus assignment with primary/backup options and automatic capacity validation
feat_fleet_point_4: Real-time bus status monitoring (active, maintenance, retired) with automated alerts
feat_fleet_point_5: Fuel efficiency tracking and cost analysis per vehicle
feat_ops_desc: Streamline trip planning and scheduling with automated templates, route optimization, and crew management to maximize efficiency and profitability.
feat_ops_point_1: Flexible trip templates with recurring schedules and seasonal adjustments
feat_ops_point_2: Automated bus and driver assignment with conflict resolution
feat_ops_point_3: Dynamic pricing per class, route, and bus type with revenue optimization
feat_ops_point_4: Route planning with distance calculation and estimated travel times
feat_ops_point_5: Crew scheduling with shift management and overtime tracking
feat_ticket_desc: Deliver exceptional customer experiences with a user-friendly booking interface, real-time seat selection, and secure payment processing.
feat_ticket_point_1: Intuitive public search widget with multi-language support and responsive design
feat_ticket_point_2: Interactive seat map with real-time availability and reserved seat handling
feat_ticket_point_3: Comprehensive PNR system with multiple payment methods and transaction tracking
feat_ticket_point_4: Automated ticket issuance with QR codes and mobile-friendly confirmations
feat_ticket_point_5: Customer booking history and easy cancellation/refund management
feat_maint_desc: Minimize downtime with predictive maintenance planning, comprehensive work order tracking, and automated inventory management for spare parts.
feat_maint_point_1: Scheduled maintenance planning with automated reminders and compliance tracking
feat_maint_point_2: Detailed work order management with technician assignments and progress monitoring
feat_maint_point_3: Spare parts inventory with supplier management and reorder alerts
feat_maint_point_4: Maintenance history and cost analysis per vehicle
feat_maint_point_5: Predictive maintenance alerts based on mileage and usage patterns
feat_hr_desc: Efficiently manage your team with employee profiles, salary tracking, license management, and performance monitoring.
feat_hr_point_1: Comprehensive employee profiles with roles, contact info, and qualifications
feat_hr_point_2: Driver license tracking with expiration alerts and renewal management
feat_hr_point_3: Salary and payroll management with automated calculations
feat_hr_point_4: Performance tracking and shift scheduling for optimal crew utilization
feat_hr_point_5: Employee training records and certification management
feat_inventory_desc: Keep your operations running smoothly with automated inventory tracking, supplier relationships, and stock level monitoring.
feat_inventory_point_1: Real-time inventory tracking with low-stock alerts and reorder automation
feat_inventory_point_2: Supplier management with performance metrics and preferred vendor lists
feat_inventory_point_3: Cost analysis and usage reporting for budget optimization
feat_inventory_point_4: Integration with maintenance for automatic parts consumption
feat_inventory_point_5: Barcode scanning support for efficient stock management
feat_clients_desc: Build stronger customer relationships with detailed profiles, booking history, and personalized communication tools.
feat_clients_point_1: Comprehensive customer profiles with contact details and preferences
feat_clients_point_2: Booking history and loyalty program integration
feat_clients_point_3: Automated customer communications and feedback collection
feat_clients_point_4: Group booking management for corporate and event clients
feat_clients_point_5: Customer analytics for targeted marketing and service improvements
feat_dashboard_desc: Gain actionable insights with real-time dashboards, customizable reports, and advanced analytics for data-driven decision making.
feat_dashboard_point_1: Real-time operational dashboards with key performance indicators
feat_dashboard_point_2: Customizable reports with export to PDF, Excel, and CSV formats
feat_dashboard_point_3: Revenue and profitability analytics with trend analysis
feat_dashboard_point_5: Predictive analytics for demand forecasting and capacity planning
feat_settings_desc: Tailor the platform to your needs with comprehensive settings for branches, states, pricing, and system-wide configurations.
feat_settings_point_2: Dynamic pricing rules and discount management
feat_settings_point_3: User role and permission management for secure access control
feat_settings_point_4: System-wide configuration for languages, currencies, and time zones
feat_settings_point_5: Integration settings for third-party services and APIs
feat_reports_desc: Access comprehensive operational and financial reports with exportable data and summary dashboards for informed decision-making.
feat_security_desc: Protect your operations with robust security measures, role-based access control, and flexible deployment options for on-premise or cloud environments.
